case_title: CONCEPCION CABALLERO ANTONIO VS. CARLOS ERNESTO MANUEL MONTANO

docket_entries.description: LEGAL REJECT LETTER PETITIONER NEEDS TO FILE AND SERVE A NEW PROOF OF SERVICE OF SUMMONS SHOWING: (A) THAT THE SERVICE PERFORMED PREVIOUSLY SERVICE WAS IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE INTER-AMERICAN SERVICE CONVENTION OR (B) NEW SERVICE IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE HAGUE SERVICE CONVENTION (SINCE THAT WILL GO INTO EFFECT 10/1/2024). LETTER CONTINUED.

LEGAL REJECT LETTER THERE IS NO INDICATION IN ANY OF YOUR PLEADINGS THAT RESPONDENT HAS THE MINIMUM CONTACTS WITH THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA NECESSARY FOR THE SUPERIOR COURT OF CALIFORNIA TO EXERCISE PERSONAL JURISDICTION OVER RESPONDENT TO ADJUDICATE YOUR REQUESTS TO [TERMINATE THE COURT'S JURISDICTION TO AWARD SPOUSAL SUPPORT TO RESPONDENT AND CONFIRM THERE IS NO COMMUNITY PROPERTY TO DIVIDE]. PLEASE FILE A DECLARATION SIGNED UNDER PENALTY OF PERJURY (THE MC-030 FORM MAY BE USED) EXPLAINING WHAT CONTACTS, IF ANY, RE

LEGAL REJECT LETTER IF RESPONDENT DOES NOT HAVE MINIMUM CONTACTS WITH THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA, YOU MAY REQUEST TO BIFURCATE AND TERMINATE THE PARTIES' MARITAL STATUS AND OBTAIN A STATUS-ONLY JUDGMENT (AS THE COURT'S JURISDICTION TO TERMINATE MARITAL STATUS IS BASED SOLELY ON EITHER PARTY'S DOMICILE IN CALIFORNIA) AND YOU MAY RESUBMIT YOUR PROPOSED JUDGMENT AS A STATUS-ONLY JUDGMENT. STATUS-ONLY JUDGMENTS MUST CONTAIN THE MANDATORY FL-347 FORM. THE COURT REQUIRES THAT BOXES 5(A) - 5(F) OF THE FL-347 FORM ARE CHECKED

LEGAL REJECT LETTER FURTHERMORE, IF YOU REQUEST A STATUS-ONLY JUDGMENT, YOU MUST JOIN AS A PARTY TO THE ACTION ANY RETIREMENT PLAN IN WHICH THERE IS A COMMUNITY INTEREST THAT IS REQUIRED TO BE JOINED UNDER FAMILY CODE SECTION 2337(D)(1) (PLEASE SEE THE FL-318-INFO SHEET FOR MORE INFORMATION).
